capabilities: Render wiki and Markdown image embeds marked with glance as compact thumbnails
Show a larger preview on hover on desktop or tap on mobile
Leave unmarked image embeds rendering normally
Isolate clicks on thumbnails from native image resize behavior
Configure thumbnail size, preview bounds, and corner radius
disambiguation: Not an image viewer or gallery; it only changes how image embeds marked with the glance marker render in notes.
extras: Manual installation instructions and release workflow details are included; the plugin states it performs no network requests, telemetry, vault scanning, or Markdown modification.
problem: Full-size image embeds interrupt reading and writing flow when a picture is only supporting context in a note.
summary: Renders image embeds marked with a glance modifier as compact inline thumbnails with a larger hover or tap preview.
